fns.desc: tls_match_altsubject_component dereferences gen->d.ia5->data without checking gen->d.ia5 is non-NULL; gen is parsed from an attacker-supplied peer certificate's subjectAltName extension (X509_get_ext_d2i), so a malformed/exotic GENERAL_NAME union member could in principle trigger a null deref during cert validation. Low-medium confidence: OpenSSL's ASN.1 template parser normally populates the matching union member for GEN_EMAIL/GEN_DNS/GEN_URI types, so real-world triggerability is unclear.

tls_cryptoapi_cert (Windows CryptoAPI path): rsa->n = BN_dup(pub_rsa->n); rsa->e = BN_dup(pub_rsa->e); neither BN_dup return is NULL-checked; on OOM either field silently stays NULL and is later used in RSA operations. Low real-world relevance: CONFIG_NATIVE_WINDOWS-only code path.
